links.outcome: Feasibility of LLM-extracted ground truth for local validation of AI on local data
links.effect: LLM-extracted labels enabled rapid performance assessment across all four diagnostic tasks; no statistically significant differences in performance between PCCT and non-PCCT cohorts.
links.quote: LLM-extracted labels enabled rapid performance assessment across all four diagnostic tasks.

links.outcome: Agreement of LLM-derived labels with human adjudication versus interreader agreement
links.effect: Agreement between LLM labels and final human annotations (κ = 0.731) comparable with interreader agreement (κ = 0.720).
links.quote: In discrepant cases, the agreement between LLM labels and final human annotations (κ = 0.731) was comparable with interreader agreement (κ = 0.720), supporting the reliability of LLM labeling.
